storyPrompt: Write a quiet English story about checking a disputed delivery before a public demonstration. Vera is a practical conservator. Ash is an assistant who is allowed to disagree. Fin keeps the public records. The story takes place at the pottery studio. The glaze box must remain intact. No character may be physically injured. Keep practical actions precise. Use third-person past tense centred on Vera. Plan three chapters, each targeting 750 words. No earlier book or borrowed fictional world is assumed.

hookSeeds: Who removed the second page of the kiln register?

chapters.turn: They establish that the second page is absent and defer opening the glaze box.

chapters.turn: They finish the small demonstration and store the intact glaze box; the delivery dispute ends.
